mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 8% signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained unemployment above 8% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production signals weakening economic activity, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained decline in industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained federal funds rate above 4% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in payroll employment above 140,000 new jobs per month signals a strengthening labor market, which increases earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises above 140000 for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of sustained rise in payroll employment above 140,000 new jobs per month (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strengthening demand, which increases earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of sustained rise in real personal consumption expenditures (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in industrial production signals strengthening economic activity, which increases earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of sustained rise in industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).
